name: Mitarai Valley
description: A mountain valley of hiking trails, waterfalls, emerald river pools, and a suspension bridge in Tenkawa. It is a single hiking anchor; individual falls and bridges are highlights, not duplicate cards.
highlights: Autumn foliage and summer mountain air

en.name: Mitarai Valley
en.description: A mountain valley of hiking trails, waterfalls, emerald river pools, and a suspension bridge in Tenkawa. It is a single hiking anchor; individual falls and bridges are highlights, not duplicate cards.
highlights: Autumn foliage and summer mountain air
en.notes: Official Nara guidance says the valley takes a little under three hours from Nara City and is best combined with an overnight stay in nearby Dorogawa Onsen. Trail conditions and seasonal closures must be checked.
en.reservation: No general timed admission is represented; check current trail, weather, and local safety guidance before hiking.
en.parking: Use designated local parking only. Public transport uses Kintetsu to Shimoichiguchi and the local bus corridor; do not infer a train-to-trailhead journey.
en.openingHours: Hours and closures vary by date; check the official visitor guidance before visiting.

ja.name: みたらい渓谷
ja.description: 天川村の渓谷に遊歩道、滝、エメラルド色の渓流、吊り橋が連なる山歩きの拠点です。個々の滝や橋は見どころとして扱い、カードを分割しません。
highlights: 滝とエメラルド色の渓流
秋の紅葉と夏の山の涼しさ
ja.notes: 奈良県の公式観光案内は奈良市から約3時間弱かかり、洞川温泉との宿泊組み合わせを勧めています。登山道の状態や季節閉鎖をご確認ください。
ja.reservation: 予約・入場条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.parking: 駐車場・アクセス条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.openingHours: 開館時間・休館日は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
